keyVerseDR: "If you had faith like to a grain of mustard seed, you might say to this mulberry tree: Be thou rooted up... And it would obey you." (Lk 17:6)

level1.title: Faith Like a Seed
level1.story: The Apostles said, "Lord, give us more faith!" Jesus said even a tiny faith like a mustard seed can do great things. We serve God because we love Him.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How big is a mustard seed?

activity.title: Faith wings
activity.intro: Write a thank-you or a prayer for faith on each feather.
activity.label: Lord, increase my faith!

level2.title: Increase Our Faith
level2.story: The apostles said to the Lord, "Increase our faith." Jesus said, "If you had faith like to a grain of mustard seed, you might say to this mulberry tree, Be thou rooted up... and it would obey you." He told of a servant who comes in from plowing and still serves his master's supper. Jesus said that when we have done all we were told, we should say, "We are unprofitable servants; we have done that which we ought to do."
level2.keyLine: If you had faith like to a grain of mustard seed.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How can small faith do great things?
Why should we serve without expecting praise?

activity.title: My thank-you prayer
activity.intro: Thank God for the gift of faith.
